contract.task_clause:
Which of the following best describes nociceptive pain?
Option A: Pain resulting from actual or potential tissue damage, which causes the release of chemical mediators that stimulate nerve fibres to initiate pain signals to the brain.
Option B: Pain resulting from pressure upon a nerve or group of nerves.
Option C: A disorder of a specific nerve or group of nerves resulting in the release of abnormal pain signals.
Option D: Pain resulting from a disorder of the central nervous system, i.e. following a cerebral vascular accident.
